title: Investigating Business in a Competitive Environment

questions.question: Assess the usefulness of decision trees in strategic decision-making under conditions of uncertainty.
questions.modelAnswer: Decision trees provide a quantitative, visual framework mapping out expected values and probabilities of different outcomes. However, they rely heavily on subjective probability estimates and ignore qualitative factors like brand reputation.
questions.reasoning: Award 2 marks for knowledge of expected values, 2 marks for contextual application, and 6 marks for balanced analytical evaluation.

questions.question: Evaluate whether corporate agility and rapid innovation or economies of scale and stability are more vital for long-term market survival.
questions.modelAnswer: Agility allows firms to pivot quickly in fast-moving digital markets. Conversely, economies of scale drive lower unit costs and pricing power. Market structure ultimately dictates which trait is prioritized.
questions.reasoning: Level 4 (16-20 marks) deep evaluation contrasting scale vs agility with industry-specific justification.
